d: Ready to be the trusted legal advisor for a growing business in the UAE?
Are you looking for an opportunity where you can take genuine ownership while continuing to develop your legal career?
Do you enjoy working independently while collaborating with experienced colleagues across multiple countries?
Location: Dubai | Scope: Middle East | Work arrangement: Hybrid | Contract type: Full-time | Reporting to: Group Legal Department | Language requirements: Fluent Arabic and English

In this newly created role, you will be the only Legal Counsel physically based in the UAE and the primary day-to-day legal contact for the local business. Your manager and the wider Legal team are located across EMEA, so you must be comfortable working independently, making sound initial assessments, taking accountability for follow-through, and proactively involving colleagues when a matter requires specialist expertise or escalation.This role is designed for an early-career talent who already has meaningful practical legal experience and is ready to step into a visible in-house counsel position. While this is not a senior role, it is also not an entry-level opportunity. We are looking for someone who is ready to take ownership, build trusted relationships with stakeholders, and contribute to the continued success of our UAE business.
q: A completed law degree and strong knowledge of UAE legal principles and procedures.
Professional fluency in both Arabic and English, with confidence communicating legal matters in both languages.
Admitted, licensed, registered, eligible to practise law in the UAE, or undertaking relevant UAE advocacy/ bar training
Practical experience drafting, reviewing, and negotiating commercial agreements (Nice-To-Have: Experience with software licensing, technology or IT-services agreements)
The ability to work independently, manage priorities, and take ownership of legal matters.
Sound judgement regarding when to resolve issues locally and when to seek specialist support or escalation.
An interest in developing a long-term career in-house and growing expertise across commercial, regulatory, technology, and data protection matters.
r: li
Serve as the primary day-to-day legal contact for SoftwareOne's UAE business.
li
Review, draft, and negotiate a range of commercial agreements, including software licensing, IT services, managed services, supplier, customer, partner, and framework contracts.
li
Provide practical, commercially focused legal guidance to internal business stakeholders.
li
Manage local legal requests from initial assessment through completion or escalation.
li
Support regulatory, authority-related, and dispute matters while coordinating with external legal counsel where required.
li
Maintain legal documentation, contract records, and follow-up activities to ensure effective matter management.
x: Build something new: Help establish and shape a newly created, locally based Legal position in the Middle East.
Develop broad in-house expertise: Work across commercial contracting, software and IT services, data protection, public-sector matters and regional legal topics.
Combine local impact with international collaboration: Take responsibility in Dubai while learning from and contributing to an experienced, cross-border Legal team.
Grow with the role: Bring strong legal foundations, curiosity and initiative, then deepen your expertise in technology-related legal work within an international business.
A company that invests: heavily in talent and training, offering continuous learning, upskilling and a supportive culture that encourages taking ownership and building long‑term expertise.

SoftwareOne is a global software and cloud solutions provider and distributor, powered by around 12,000 people across more than 70 countries. But what really makes us SoftwareOne is our people: curious minds, different perspectives, and talented teams working together to solve real challenges and create meaningful impact. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to grow, explore new possibilities, and build a career that’s uniquely yours, while helping shape what’s next in technology.

d: HanmiGlobal is seeking a highly qualified Senior Electrical Engineer to join our program management and PMCM team in Saudi Arabia. In this role, you will deliver program-level electrical engineering expertise and technical governance for a mega multi-work package land and infrastructure development program in Riyadh, delivered on behalf of a major government entity.

You will be providing program-level technical expertise, engineering assurance, and collaborative oversight for reviewing and monitoring all electrical designs across the program, ensuring all power distribution systems, substations, electrical utility networks, and street lighting systems are fully integrated and compliant with approved design standards, utility requirements, statutory regulations, and operational needs under the direction of the Technical Manager, while supporting the successful delivery of the overall development program.
q: Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university.
Chartered Professional membership or equivalent professional accreditation.

Minimum fifteen (15) years of professional experience in electrical infrastructure, power distribution systems, utility networks, urban development, infrastructure delivery, or major capital projects.

Experience within PMCM, PMC, consultancy, developer, contractor, utility organizations, or client-side organizations, preferably on major infrastructure and land development programs in Saudi Arabia or the GCC.
Leadership, Strategic Thinking, Communication, and Problem Solving
r: li

Review and assess electrical engineering reports, design calculations, load studies, specifications, drawings, power demand analyses, and technical submissions to ensure compliance with approved standards, utility requirements, Client’s requirements, and project objectives.
li
Evaluate electrical engineering solutions for safety, reliability, resilience, operability, maintainability, energy efficiency, sustainability, and lifecycle performance.
li
Review power distribution systems, medium- and low-voltage networks, substations, electrical utility corridors, street lighting systems, and associated electrical infrastructure.
li

Assess electrical load forecasts, network capacities, utility interface requirements, and power supply strategies while ensuring effective integration with transportation, telecommunications, utilities, facilities, and other infrastructure systems.
li
Coordinate with utility providers and regulatory authorities to support approvals, technical compliance, and infrastructure integration.
li
Support engineering governance by reviewing technical compliance, engineering deviations, design modifications, and Value Engineering proposals.
li
Assess the impact of design changes on safety, reliability, operational efficiency, sustainability, cost, schedule, maintainability, and lifecycle performance.
li
Provide technical recommendations to support informed engineering decisions and effective risk mitigation throughout the program lifecycle.
li
Coordinate with Lead Developers, consultants, contractors, utility providers, government authorities, and regulatory agencies on electrical engineering matters, approvals, and technical compliance.
li
Prepare technical assessments, engineering review comments, executive summaries, and recommendations for the Technical Manager, PMCM Management, and the Client.
li

Participate in multidisciplinary design reviews, technical workshops, coordination meetings, and stakeholder engagement sessions while promoting engineering excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.
